sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2003
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province
Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary 10th November, 2003]
No.Legis: 1(14)/73/6455.,
dated 10-11-2003.-----The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Finance (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into, force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 11. of N.-W. F. P. Act No I of 1996

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2003
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2003
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province
Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary 10th November, 2003]
No.Legis: 1(14)/73/6455.,
dated 10-11-2003.-----The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 11. of
N.-W. F. P. Act No I of 1996----In the North-West frontier Province Finance
Act, 1996 (N. W. F. P. Act No. I of 1996), in section 11. for sub section (1);
the following sub sections shall be substituted., namely:
" 11. Tobacco development
cess.---(1) There shall be levied and collected development cess on tobacco
at the following rates, namely:
(a) for Virginia (flue cured, burley and Rs. 2.00 per kilogram.
dark
air cured);
(b) for white patta/rustica tobacco Re. 1.00 per kilogram
including
khake, Kara and Roth
made
of mainstalk (dandi) and stem
of
tobacco; and
(c) for snuff/niswar. Re.
0.70 per kilogram,
(1a) The cess shall be recovered
from---
(a) tobacco manufacturing
factories on the basis of quota fixed factory concerned by the Pakistan Tobacco
Board; and
(b) persons dealing in tobacco
business, who are transporting one of its production:
Provided that tobacco
manufacturing factories shall not be liable to pay the cess on tobacco on which
cess has already been paid under
Provided further that no cess
shall be charged on the tobacco being transported, for which the cess has
already been paid under clause
Explanation.---For the
purpose of this section, (i) there shall be the following Zones, namely:
Zone-I. Districts of Charsadda,
Swabi, Mardan, Nowshera, Tehsil Dargai and lower areas of District Buner adjoining
District Swabi.
Zone-II. District Mansehra;
Zone-III. Districts of Chitral,
Dir and Swat (which includes Kalam) and Malakand Protected Area; and
such other Zones as Government
may, from time to time, by notification in the official Gazette, specify; and
(ii) the word 'person' used in
clause (b) of sub section (1a) shall also include tobacco manufacturing
factories, if these factories are transporting tobacco outside the Zone in
addition to the quota allocated to them by the Pakistan Tobacco Board."
